jobs.title: Confirmed Backend Engineer - Care
jobs.description:
About BlaBlaCar

BlaBlaCar is the world’s leading community-based travel app enabling 27 million members a year to carpool or travel by bus in 21 countries. Our team of 800 employees counts over 50 nationalities and is spread across our 5 global offices, 30% working fully remotely.

We are looking for a Confirmed Backend Engineer to join the Care team at BlaBlaCar.

As part of the Corporate Services pillar, your mission will be to empower our Community Relations Team (CRT) with the tools they need to have a 360-degree view of the user journey across our platform.

The Care team's primary objective is to build "Phoenix," our new, comprehensive back-office system. This service aggregates data from all other teams and supply lines (train, carpool, and bus), while also providing critical action capabilities regarding our users, such as account blocking and content moderation.

Your role will be to contribute to the creation of this unified back-office and to ensure our customer relation agents can operate seamlessly.

You will work within a multi-stack team of 3 Backend & 1 Frontend Engineer. You will collaborate closely with the Community Relations Team (CRT) as well as with Product Managers from other teams to best define needs and ensure seamless integration across the company.

Design, build, and evolve the services of the BlaBlaCar Backoffice

-

Your Qualifications

-

You have solid experience from companies with a strong engineering culture, within a growth context

-

jobs.title: Engineering Manager Post-Booking Squad
jobs.description:

BlaBlaCar is the world’s leading community-based travel app enabling 27 million members a year to carpool or travel by bus in 21 countries. Our team of 800 employees counts over 50 nationalities and is spread across our 5 global offices, 30% working fully remotely.

Your mission

A great travel experience doesn’t end once the "Book" button is clicked. At BlaBlaCar, ensuring peace of mind and flexibility after the purchase is the mission of the Post-booking squad. Whether it’s accessing an e-ticket, managing a ride plan, or handling cancellations and exchanges, their role is to provide a seamless, trustable, and transparent experience that supports passengers every step of the way until they reach their destination.

As Engineering Manager of the Post-booking squad, your mission is to lead a diverse, talented team of frontend and backend engineers to build a scalable and reliable "After-Book" platform. You will be at the heart of BlaBlaCar’s transformation into a global marketplace, tackling the challenge of unifying post-booking services for carpool, bus, and train supplies into a single, high-performance architecture.

You will achieve this by partnering closely with a dedicated Product Manager, a Product Designer, and our Data team to define the vision, execute the roadmap, and drive a culture of technical excellence across the company.

Your responsibilities

-

Engineering Leadership: Act as the main engineering advisor to the Product Manager and business stakeholders, participating in the definition of the squad’s objectives and long-term technical roadmap

-

Delivery Management: Facilitate the planning and delivery of complex, cross-team projects while ensuring performance, stability, and long-term scalability

-

Stakeholder Management: Collaborate with Product Managers from the OTA, Bus, Train, and Carpool teams to prioritize deliveries according to our business objectives and report on your squad’s progress

-

People Management: Recruit, inspire, and grow your team of engineers through mentorship, career development, and regular feedback

-

Operational Excellence: Foster a culture of innovation and continuous improvement, ensuring the team leverages modern tools (like AI-driven acceleration) to maintain high productivity and quality

Your qualifications

-

Management Experience: A confirmed experience in a management position with proven people management skills

-

Technical Background: Experience in building reliable, scalable, and secure consumer-facing products, ideally with knowledge across backend (Java, Spring) and frontend (Kotlin, Swift, React, TypeScript) stacks

-

Communication: Strong leadership and communication skills in English, with the ability to bridge the gap between technical constraints and business/compliance requirements

-

Problem-Solving: A track record of "getting things done" and the ability to take a step back to prioritize added-value tasks in a high-stakes environment

Foundations is composed of seven teams which “provide consistent, easy to use, infrastructures, services, and expertise to support BlaBlaCar’s growth and evolution”.

The Site Reliability Engineering team (SRE) is responsible to provide best in class Observability, Alerting and Incident management tools and processes to service teams. As an enabling team, we help BlaBlacar engineers to efficiently improve their service reliability. Empowering developers and bringing them our reliability expertise are at the core of our daily work.

-

Core Infrastructure: Kubernetes, Google Cloud Platform

-

GitOps/Delivery: GitHub, Terraform, Flux, Helm, Jenkins

-

While developers handle incidents within their scope, you could step in as Incident Commander during high-severity incidents, leading coordination efforts .

Your Mission

As the Product Manager for the Discover squad, you will focus on the upper funnel of the passenger journey. Your mission is to capture global traffic via SEO and emerging LLM-based search (GEO), ensuring passengers have a seamless experience when they land on our platform. You will build a vision that maximizes conversion from all acquisition channels, prioritizing high-impact projects across our core markets.

- Stakeholder Influence: Strong interpersonal skills to navigate cross-functional relationships, gain buy-in, and clearly communicate prioritization decisions.

The Data Demand team’s mission is to help BlaBlaCar grow as a global OTA through data, covering the full customer journey from brand and product discovery through marketing and landing pages, to search, booking, post-booking, and payment. As the team expands its scope from self-service towards decision intelligence, we want to strengthen our ability to proactively analyse member, marketplace, and product behaviours, and to influence the decisions that shape the product.

As a Data Analyst, you will join the Data Demand team to drive decision-making through data: framing the right questions with stakeholders, going deep into data to explain what is happening, sizing opportunities, interpreting experiments, and translating insights into actionable recommendations for Product and Marketing teams.

jobs.title: Stagiaire Marketing & Réseaux Sociaux France
jobs.description:
À propos de BlaBlaCar

BlaBlaCar est la première communauté mondiale de covoiturage et de voyage en bus, rassemblant plus de 26 millions de membres chaque année dans 21 pays. Nos 700 collaborateurs, issus de plus de 50 nationalités, sont répartis dans 5 bureaux internationaux, avec 30 % de l’équipe en télétravail complet.

Rejoindre BlaBlaCar, c’est participer à une aventure humaine et technologique unique, au service d’une mission : rendre la mobilité partagée plus accessible, conviviale et durable.

Ta mission

Envie d'un stage marketing qui ne se résume pas à une seule casquette ? Au sein de l'équipe Business & Marketing France, tu rejoindras une équipe qui pilote la croissance de la communauté BlaBlaCar sur l'ensemble de nos activités (covoiturage, bus, train) et à partir de Janvier 2027.

Ce stage a été pensé comme une vraie immersion dans la gestion de projet marketing : tu seras au cœur de plusieurs projets à fort impact, en lien direct avec le Marketing Lead France. Concrètement, tu piloteras la relation avec notre agence social media, tu contribueras à des campagnes d'influence, tu collaboreras avec les équipes relations presse pour faire rayonner la marque dans l'actualité, et tu prendras en main un vrai projet e-commerce : la boutique de goodies BlaBlaCar.

Un stage généraliste, concret, et taillé pour quelqu'un qui veut toucher à tout en marketing et pas seulement aux réseaux sociaux.

Sur le volet réseaux sociaux, l'enjeu principal sera clair et mesurable : faire grandir notre compte TikTok, aujourd'hui à un peu moins de 50 000 followers, avec un objectif de croissance ambitieux sur la durée du stage. Pour t'aider à l'atteindre, tu disposeras d'un budget mensuel dédié à la sponsorisation de contenu, et surtout d'un vrai niveau d'ownership : on attend de toi que tu sois force de proposition sur les leviers à activer pour aller chercher ces objectifs de croissance, pas seulement que tu exécutes un plan déjà écrit.

Tes responsabilités

Réseaux sociaux & contenu

-

Être le point de contact privilégié de notre agence social media : brief, suivi de production, reporting de performance.

-

Contribuer à la stratégie de contenus (TikTok, Instagram, LinkedIn…) et identifier les tendances à adapter aux codes de BlaBlaCar.

-

Suivre et analyser les performances des campagnes (reach, engagement, conversions) et en tirer des recommandations

Influence & relations presse

-

Participer à la gestion de campagnes d'influenceurs, du sourcing au suivi des livrables.

-

Travailler avec les équipes relations presse pour construire des campagnes réactives à l'actualité et donner de la visibilité à la marque.

Gestion de projet e-commerce

-

Prendre en main la boutique de goodies BlaBlaCar : mise en vente, mise en avant auprès de la communauté, suivi des ventes.

-

Proposer des idées pour dynamiser l'offre et créer de l'engagement autour de ces produits.

Transverse

-

Collaborer avec les équipes Brand, Design et CRM pour amplifier les campagnes.

-

Participer à la veille concurrentielle et sectorielle : mobilité, tendances réseaux sociaux, bonnes pratiques.

-

Soutenir ponctuellement les campagnes marketing locales (CRM, activations offline/online).

Ton profil

-

Tu es actuellement en Master 1 ou 2 (École de commerce, Université ou équivalent).

-

Tu disposes d’une première expérience en marketing ou en gestion de réseaux sociaux.

-

Tu es curieux(se) et à l'aise pour jongler entre plusieurs sujets à la fois: réseaux sociaux, influence, e-commerce.

-

Tu es créatif(ve), curieux(se), et force de proposition

-

Tu es structuré(e), organisé(e) et capable de gérer plusieurs projets en parallèle.

-

Tu t’exprimes parfaitement en français et tu es à l’aise en anglais (oral et écrit).

-

Tu es basé(e) à Paris (ou prêt(e) à y travailler).

-

Tu maîtrises les outils de travail classiques (Canva, Powerpoint, Excel…) et tu sauras vite t’adapter aux outils réseaux sociaux (Outils de planification, Montage Video…)

Les outils avec lesquels tu vas travailler

Tu monteras en compétences sur un ensemble d'outils recherchés dans le marketing digital : Google Slides pour la création de supports, TikTok Business Suite et Meta Business Suite pour le reporting et la gestion de campagnes sur les réseaux sociaux, ainsi que des outils de création comme Canva et Figma.

Aucune maîtrise préalable n'est attendue sur ces outils au démarrage du stage — c'est justement une vraie montée en compétences sur laquelle tu pourras progresser tout au long de ces 6 mois, et que tu pourras valoriser comme une expertise concrète à l'issue du stage.

Ce que nous offrons :

-

Fourchette de salaire : 1.000 - 1.200 euros brut/mois

-

Mode de travail hybride

-

Un jour de congé par mois

-

Politique de repas locale (carte Swile)

-

50 % des frais de transport pris en charge (Forfait Mobilités Durables)

-

Covoiturage et trajets en bus gratuits et illimités

-

Développement personnel via des formations, du mentorat et des programmes de mobilité interne

-

Événements réguliers de team building

-

Soutien à la santé mentale via Moka.care

-

1 jour de congé par an pour tester notre produit

-

1 jour par an dédié à des actions solidaires avec des associations

Le processus de recrutement :

-

Un entretien vidéo (45 min) avec notre Talent Acquisition Manager.

-

Un entretien (45 min) avec ton futur manager, Erwann Bouhier.

-

Un échange sur les tendances des réseaux sociaux avec la Brand Manager et un membre de l’équipe (30-45 mins).

Durée moyenne du process : 3 à 4 semaines.

👉 Merci de noter qu’une convention de stage délivrée par ton établissement est obligatoire pour candidater.

jobs.title: Compensation & Benefits Specialist
jobs.description:
About BlaBlaCar

BlaBlaCar is the world’s leading community-based travel app enabling 27 million members a year to carpool or travel by bus in 21 countries. Our team of 800 employees counts over 50 nationalities and is spread across our 5 global offices, 30% working fully remotely.

We are looking for a Compensation & Benefits Specialist with 5+ years of hands-on experience to support, evolve and operate our global C&B programs. This is a hands-on role with real ownership, sitting at the intersection of rigorous analysis and day-to-day operational delivery, mixing 60% run 40% projects.

You will be the C&B specialist of the People team, reporting directly to the Head of Talent, Culture & Performance. You will partner closely with the DRH, the Remuneration Committee, People Ops, and local HR teams to ensure BlaBlaCar's compensation programs are competitive, equitable and compliant — and ready for the EU Pay Transparency Directive (effective 2027).

The role covers the full C&B spectrum across BlaBlaCar's international footprint (France, Brazil, Poland, Ukraine, Spain and beyond): base salary architecture, variable compensation, equity programs (AGA / BSPCE / O-shares / M-shares), employee savings (PEE/PERCO, intéressement), and benefits.

Your responsibilities

- Participate in designing, then implementing and managing the Compensation & Benefits strategy across BlaBlaCar

- Update and maintain BlaBlaCar's salary grid and grading system (L1–L7) per job function, ensuring it remains grounded on relevant external surveys and benchmarks (AON Radford / Ravio)

- Review and enhance variable compensation programs, leave & benefits across all geographies (France, Brazil, Poland, Ukraine, Spain)

- Participate in budget creation and follow-up its consumption

- Lead the annual End-of-Year compensation review process globally

- Prepare meetings, minutes, presentations and data for the Remuneration Committee (RemCo)

At BlaBlaCar, this also means:

- Supporting the administration of all equity programs (O-shares, M-shares, AGA, BSPCE): contributing to pool design and grant calibration under the Head of TCP's oversight, applying vesting rules and reconciling the Comuto transaction ledger

- Configuring and operating the Workday Advanced Compensation module: salary ranges, cycle setup, reporting and dashboards

- Contributing to pay transparency readiness ahead of the EU Directive (2027): conducting pay equity analyses and supporting compliance mapping and the remediation roadmap

- Overseeing employee savings programs (PEE/PERCO, intéressement) and the international C&B policy roadmap

Your qualifications

Required

- 5+ years of hands-on experience in Compensation & Benefits, in an international environment

- Strong expertise in job architecture, salary range design and market benchmarking (AON Radford, Mercer, Ravio or equivalent)

- Experience with EU Pay Transparency Directive readiness or pay equity analysis

- Experience supporting equity programs (AGA, BSPCE, RSU or equivalent), including grant cycle administration

- Solid command of French C&B regulatory frameworks: AGA/BSPCE, intéressement, PEE/PERCO, working time compliance

- Advanced analytical skills — comfortable managing large datasets; experience with Workday Advanced Compensation strongly preferred

- Demonstrated experience in a Tech scale-up or company with multi-sites, multi-country and/or multi-collective agreements C&B scope

- Rigorous and comfortable preparing materials and contributing to discussions with senior stakeholders (RemCo, DRH, ExCo)

- Full professional proficiency in English and French

Nice to Have

- Familiarity with Workday-to-benchmark API integrations or HRIS automation projects

- Prior experience with Ravio, Pigment or similar compensation intelligence tools

What we have to offer

- a 45-min video-call with Elodie, TA Team Lead, to get to know you, understand your career expectations and answer your questions

- a 60-min video-call with Pierre, Head of Talent, Culture & Performance, to discuss your experience and share more details about the position

- a 90-min case study with our People Team

- a 30-min video-call with Frédéric, CHRO, for vision fit and rounding off the process

BlaBlaCar is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.
